program.name: Chin-up Biceps
program.subject: Pull-ups
program.blurb: Chin-ups with curl supersets for arms and back, then a day of pulls and presses.
program.about: Chin-ups train the back and the biceps at once, so this program leans into it. One day supersets chin-ups and chin holds with curls; the other mixes pull-ups and rows with presses so the chest keeps up. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for heavier dumbbells and Level III adds reps.
